Soft Glam

A polished, second-skin finish with a diffused glow.

About this look

Soft Glam is the everyday signature: a blurred base, a warm wash of neutral shadow and a skin-like glow. It reads polished on camera and effortless in daylight.

The direction

  • A second-skin, blurred base
  • Warm neutral shadow wash
  • A diffused lit-from-within glow

How to recreate it

  1. Even the complexion with a light skin tint, blending outward.
  2. Sweep a neutral shadow across the lid and softly into the crease.
  3. Add a touch of highlighter to the high points of the cheekbone.
  4. Finish the lip with a conditioning lip oil in a nude tone.
